passages.text:
Re: Connecting OTI Ethiopia with Twitter
[contact omitted] Akemi Tinder Monday, November 15, 2021 at 12:08:43 PM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Madalina Cristoloveanu
[opaque block] [contact omitted]
Hi Pete,
It's good to e-meet you, and thanks, Madalina, for putting us in touch. I'm the acting deputy team lead for the OTI Ethiopia
team in DC.
We'd definitely welcome a conversation. Please let me know what your availability looks like over the next few days and
perhaps a bit more background on what you'd like to discuss, and l'll work out a time to meet with my colleagues here.
Thanks - look forward to speaking with you,
Akemi
On Mon, Nov 15, 2021 at 11:14 AM Madalina Cristoloveanu <[contact omitted]> wrote:
With Pete's correct address this time.
Madalina Cristoloveanu
Team Leader, Europe
USAID/OTI
[opaque block]
On Mon, Nov 15, 2021 at 11:02 AM Madalina Cristoloveanu <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Akemi and Pete,
I spoke with both of you this morning and wanted to make sure I connect you both by email. Akemi is currently
upportina the OT Ethiopia team in DC. Pete (who | have known for manv vears) works with Twitter and mentione
nat the Twitter Policv team is interested in talkina to USAID (and OTI) about dinsinfo/misinfo/hate speech in Ethioni:
I will let Pete explain more. Please take it from here.
M
Madalina Cristoloveanu
Team Leader, Europe
USAID/OTI
[opaque block]
Akemi Tinder
Sr Transition Advisor
USAID/Office of Transition Initiatives (OTI)
[contact omitted]
Mobile: [opaque block]
